post.summary: Acquire a consistent read-only snapshot lease
post.description: Capture committed state at one sequence across all collections. Consumes bounded extra RAM and a snapshot slot. Lease expires after the advertised TTL; operations admitted before expiry may finish under the same operation deadline. No writes are accepted through a snapshot.

BearerAuth.description: Configured API key in Authorization: Bearer <key>. No query parameter, cookie, or browser credential fallback.

RequestTimeout.name: X-Recern-Timeout-Ms
RequestTimeout.description: Server-side budget from request headers received, including body, queue and execution. Must be <= advertised max_timeout_ms; absence uses advertised default_timeout_ms. Clients impose their own total HTTP deadline.

CollectionName.description: 1–255 UTF-8 bytes, valid Unicode. No normalization or case folding. Never placed in a URL.

LogicalId.description: 0–65,536 UTF-8 bytes, including empty, slash, newline and NUL characters. A string, never a numeric ID.

Identity.description: Opaque durable database or collection generation. Clients compare exactly; never derive it from a name.

Uint64.description: Base-10 uint64 in a string (0 through 18446744073709551615). Never a JSON number.

Cursor.description: Opaque authenticated page position. Bound to database, boot, collection generation, view and revision. Not a migration journal.

SnapshotId.description: Opaque read-only snapshot lease; authenticated requests are still required.

Vector.description: Finite numbers rounded once to float32. Length must equal dim. Sum of squared float32 coordinates <= float32.max/8; cosine requires norm squared >= float32.min_normal.

JsonValue.description: Finite JSON values; integers must fit signed/unsigned 64 bits. Max nesting 64. Runtime validation also enforces UTF-8 and encoded-byte limits.

MetadataJson.description: JSON text inside a string. Decode with lossless 64-bit integers and integer/float kinds; do not pass through JavaScript JSON.parse/JSON.stringify when they lose those distinctions. Runtime validates both the UTF-8 text size and portable canonical size <= 1 MiB.

Filter.description: Portable profile v1 filter. Object entries are AND; paths traverse objects only. Empty object matches all. At most 64 JSON nesting levels and 1 MiB.

FilterJson.description: JSON text containing a portable filter. Omitted/null means no filter; the string "null" is invalid. Preserve literal numeric kinds for structural equality. Content schemas are checked explicitly by the conformance tests.

distance.description: Finite smaller-is-closer distance. Cosine max(0,1-similarity), squared L2, or negative dot product.

Capabilities.description: snapshot_pages is false on the live client, true on a leased snapshot. Capability guarantees are scoped to this single-node contract.

message.description: Sanitized explanation without request bodies, logical IDs, collection names, keys or local paths.

write_outcome.description: No error claims that a write committed. A lost or malformed response is always ambiguous for a submitted mutation.

Error400.description: Malformed JSON, duplicate keys, invalid fields, types, Unicode, vectors, filters or cursor.
